research_purpose: Prevent false claims that the 35 unsourced named finished-article cases have no applicable contaminant rule; distinguish metal-specific 'Foods not specified' from the methylmercury 'All foods' article.
source_date_effective_basis: CTR Version IX on 13 October 2026; May 2026 changes with prospective start are not imported.

official_rule_rows.decision: Do not use unless the finished food lacks a more specific Lead article under the current legal table.
Do not use until the named Copper articles and their sample bases have been checked.
Do not use until the named Arsenic food/substance articles have been checked.
Canned food and other tin-specific named articles must be evaluated first; packaging affects scope.
Do not substitute this default for a specifically named cadmium food/commodity.
This total-Mercury row is different from Methyl Mercury and may have food-specific competitors.
The legal table expressly says All foods. This is not a finished-product-specific first named article and does not establish a test PASS.
